text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Before the race, Hishi Miracle drew a 
winning slip from a good-luck lottery that 
had a 3-in-8 chance.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Though her resolve may still falter, she 
has put in the work. With a faint glimmer 
of confidence in her heart, she takes on 
the final crown of the Classic Triple 
Crown.
